The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was most likely Tulsi Lal Amatya, chosen by the municipal council. I can't check a source in this session, so please verify against a reference such as Wikipedia's list of Kathmandu mayors. The team note's alternative, Bishweshwar Prasad Koirala, is not a name I associate with the Kathmandu mayoralty; he was a Nepali political leader and later prime minister.

CONFIDENCE: 70
